facts.text: Serve the mains when Hooch wrecks the car.
facts.why: Wikiquote has Scott finding Hooch ripping the car seat apart ('You're eating the car!'), so Hooch wrecking the car is in the film.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Hooch wrecks Scott's house.

facts.text: My house was clean until the dog moved in. Pass the napkins, there is drool everywhere.
facts.why: Scott never says this and it is set in quote marks. It is an invented line, even though the neat freak versus slobbery dog joke is the film's engine.
facts.fix: Set it as an unquoted note: Scott's rule, wipe the dog first.

fix_note.text: My house was clean until the dog moved in. Pass the napkins, there is drool everywhere.
